articles.title: ‘Ludicrous’: VIA Rail stopping service at Guildwood, Malton stations
articles.summary: VIA Rail trains will no longer stop at Guildwood and Malton stations starting next month, with the Crown corporation saying the elimination will improve travel times. But passengers in Scarborough say it will do the exact opposite for them. They’ll now have to travel to either Union Station or Oshawa, to connect with VIA service. […]

articles.title: VIA Rail ending service at Guildwood and Malton stations starting Oct. 25
articles.summary: VIA Rail will be dropping service to Guildwood and Malton stations starting Oct. 25. The decision has drawn criticism from local commuters, though VIA Rail maintains the change is justified by the stops' proximity to Union Station and existing GO Transit connections.

articles.title: 'Don't close, don't sell': Union implores Stellantis to keep Brampton plant as automaker signals sale
articles.summary: The union representing Canadian workers at Stellantis is urging the automaker to keep its commitment to retooling its Brampton Ont., plant as the company looks poised to sell it instead.

articles.title: Police officers could be coming back to schools in York Region after program previously scrapped
articles.summary: Trustees from the York Region District School Board (YRDSB) have passed a motion giving staff six months to report back on how to bring back a program that puts police officers in schools.

articles.title: 16-year-old charged with 1st-degree murder after teen shot in North York
articles.summary: A teenager has been arrested three days after 17-year-old Cashie Auguste was fatally shot near Jane Street and Finch Avenue W., police say. The accused has been charged with first-degree murder and failure to comply with a probation order, investigators said in an update Thursday.

articles.title: King Street W. streetcar service changes are coming — again. Here's what you need to know
articles.summary: Major infrastructure work on a stretch of King Street W. will mean several changes to TTC streetcar service for 10 months starting this fall.

articles.title: Ford, Joly call on Stellantis to make new model at Brampton plant after automaker signals potential sale
articles.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford and federal Industry Minister Mélanie Joly are calling on Stellantis to produce a new model at its idled Brampton, Ont., assembly plant after the automaker signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Canadian armoured vehicle maker Roshel on its potential sale.

articles.title: Crown drops charge against Toronto man accused in Pearson airport gold heist
articles.summary: Prosecutors have withdrawn a charge against a Toronto man accused of taking part in the multimillion-dollar gold heist at Pearson airport in 2023.
